# Sygehus Sønderjylland

Sygehus Sønderjylland is a Danish hospital that participates in the DANIBD registry, a national database tracking inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) treatment patterns across Denmark. As of the 2023–2024 reporting period, the hospital was actively treating 313 patients receiving biological drug therapy (BMSL—biologisk lægemiddelbehandling), a class of advanced treatments for IBD. Among these patients, 177 (57%) carried a diagnosis of Crohn's disease and 136 (43%) had ulcerative colitis [^src1]. These figures reflect Sygehus Sønderjylland's role within a broader clinical surveillance effort documenting treatment outcomes, medication use, and surgical interventions for inflammatory bowel disease in both adult and pediatric populations across Denmark for the period from October 2023 to September 2024.
